svg.title: Put three numbers in the contract - how fast they reply depends on how bad it is. Three stacked rows. Severity 1, marked in red: the app is down, or nobody can pay you - reply in 2 business hours. Severity 2, marked in amber: a feature broke, but there is a workaround - reply in 8 business hours. Severity 3, in grey: typos and cosmetic glitches - reply in 2 business days. Footer note: these are fair asks, and you name your own timezone for business hours.
svg.desc: Hand-drawn severity ladder: three rows, each with a coloured severity badge, the plain-English meaning of that level, and the first-reply deadline to write into the contract.
svg.text: Put three numbers in the contract
how fast they reply depends on how bad it is
app is down - or nobody can pay you
a feature broke - there is a workaround
Fair asks - and name YOUR timezone for business hours.
